# Linux: first real attempt exits 7; no second execution before cancellation.
skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json backoff
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id backoff
json-value id JOB
await-state $JOB retrying
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'retry_backoff'
cmp starts one-start.txt
skygo jobs cancel $JOB --yes
await-state $JOB canceled
cmp starts one-start.txt
assert-native 0
assert-output 0

-- one-start.txt --
start
